body:
## Status: implementation complete; full package test suite green

### Files changed
**Step layer**
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/step/mod.rs` — added `Step::ReplaceDoc`, `Step::SetInlineAttr`, `Step::SetMarkAttr`; extended `step_map` (ReplaceDoc = replacement at 0 from old size to new size), `is_noop`, `range_of` (None for ReplaceDoc, range for attr steps).
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/step/apply.rs` — apply/owned apply arms for all three; moved node/doc attr code out to keep files ≤300 (229 lines).
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/step/invert.rs` — inverse arms; ReplaceDoc inverse restores the pre-step doc; inline attr captures old value; mark attr captures old value, and falls back to `ReplaceDoc` when runs disagree (exact undo for mixed link attrs).
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/step/inline_attr.rs` (new, 139) — validates one-byte atom range, atom kind/attr/value via `Schema::validate_attrs`, rebuilds `TextBlock`.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/step/mark_attr.rs` (new, 237) — sets attrs on runs already carrying the mark, validates mark/attr/value against `MarkSpec`, scans old values for inversion.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/step/node_attr.rs` (new, 108) — extracted `SetNodeAttr`/`SetDocAttr`/`replace_block_owned` verbatim (no behavior change).

**State layer**
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/transaction_attrs.rs` (new, 79) — `Transaction::replace_document`, `::set_inline_attr`, `::set_mark_attr` (empty mark range queues nothing).
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/mod.rs` — `step_bytes` accounts ReplaceDoc size; module registration.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/change.rs` — ReplaceDoc sets `full`; attr steps emit old==new ranges.

**Tests**
- `tests/step_attrs.rs` (185): replace-doc apply/invert/undo/redo + step_map + ChangeSet.full; inline image width set/invert; rejects structural-token, 2-byte, wrong-type, and text-run ranges.
- `tests/step_mark_attrs.rs` (139): link href set/invert; mixed-run set with exact undo.

### Verification (exact)
- `cargo test -p rich-editor-auy --locked` → **all green** (20 test binaries, incl. both new files).
- `rustfmt --check` on all touched files → clean.
- File length: all my files ≤300.

### Blockers outside my scope (peer in-flight, not mine)
- `cargo clippy -p rich-editor-auy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` fails with **only** peer-owned errors: `src/model/table.rs:90 field problems is never read` and `src/model/table/grid.rs:55 pub(crate) function inside private module`. My files report zero clippy findings.
- `./scripts/check_file_length.sh` fails on `tests/schema_full.rs: 491 lines` (peer file).

### Deviation to note
`Step::ReplaceDoc` carries `old_size: u32` in addition to `doc`. The required `step_map` semantics (“old size → new size at 0”) cannot be computed from the new doc alone; `Transaction::replace_document` derives it from the transaction base doc and errors with `StepError::Unsupported("replace_document_without_base")` if no base exists (only possible via `Transaction::new()`, unused in-tree).

SetMarkAttr is implemented (not omitted); mixed per-run old values use a precise `ReplaceDoc` inverse instead of a lossy single-value inverse.

**Files delivered overall**: `src/step/{mod.rs, apply.rs, invert.rs, inline_attr.rs, mark_attr.rs, node_attr.rs}`, `src/state/{mod.rs, change.rs, transaction_attrs.rs}`, `tests/{step_attrs.rs, step_mark_attrs.rs}`.

**Noted deviations/blocks already reported**: `ReplaceDoc` carries `old_size` to satisfy the required `step_map` semantics; `Transaction::replace_document` needs a base doc. `check_file_length.sh` still flags peer-owned `tests/schema_full.rs` (491 lines).

All green confirmed on both sides — no further action needed from me.

**Final status: assigned work complete and verified.**

- `Step::ReplaceDoc` (+ `Transaction::replace_document`), `Step::SetInlineAttr` (+ `Transaction::set_inline_attr`), and `Step::SetMarkAttr` (+ `Transaction::set_mark_attr`) implemented with apply/invert/step_map/range_of/ChangeSet/step_bytes coverage.
- Exhaustive matches updated in `step/apply.rs`, `step/invert.rs`, `step/mod.rs`, `state/change.rs`, `state/mod.rs`; new modules keep every `src/` file ≤300 lines.
- Delivered files: `src/step/{mod.rs, apply.rs, invert.rs, inline_attr.rs, mark_attr.rs, node_attr.rs}`, `src/state/{mod.rs, change.rs, transaction_attrs.rs}`, `tests/{step_attrs.rs, step_mark_attrs.rs}`.
- Verification: `cargo clippy -p rich-editor-auy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` exit 0; `cargo test -p rich-editor-auy --locked` all suites green (EditorCore independently confirmed 23 suites, 0 failures, clippy 0); rustfmt clean on my files.
- Known deviations/notes: `ReplaceDoc` stores `old_size` (required for the specified 0→old-size→new-size step map) and `Transaction::replace_document` requires a transaction base doc; mixed-run `SetMarkAttr` inversion uses a precise `ReplaceDoc` inverse; `check_file_length.sh` still flags only the peer-owned `tests/schema_full.rs`.
